```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(compositions)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(vegan)
library(dendextend)
library(umap)
```

## Load data
```{r}
load("../manuscript/data/clinical.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/microbiome_metadata.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/counts-wide.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/counts-long.rds")
#load("../manuscript/data/ra-wide.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/events.rds")
```

## Prepare data... 
- CLR transformation? or use RA
- Need to define time points 

```{r}
# counts
taxa <- counts.w %>%
  # remove major outlier 
  # dplyr::select(-`FF08034405`) %>%
  column_to_rownames("microbe") 

# add pseudo count for CLR transformation 
taxa[taxa == 0] <- 1 
clr_taxa <- t(apply(taxa, 1, function(x) clr(x)))

# Remove 0 variance taxa - n=891
non_constant_taxa <- apply(clr_taxa, 1, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0
clr_taxa_filt <- clr_taxa[non_constant_taxa, ]
clr_taxa_filt_t <- t(clr_taxa_filt)

# check order and add demogrpahic info
meta <- mic.meta %>%
  # remove major outlier 
  # filter(!sample == "FF08034405") %>%
  left_join(demographics)

all.equal(rownames(clr_taxa_filt_t), meta$sample)
```

## Clustering

# PCA 

```{r}
pca_result <- prcomp(clr_taxa_filt_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

pca_df <- merge(pca_df, meta, by = "sample")
```

# Plot 

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = `Patient Id`)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  # remove outlier from visual field 
  #xlim(-10, 5) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = `Patient Id`), level = 0.95, linetype = "dashed")
```

One major outlier M018, Sample FF08034405. This sample seems to be missing a lot
of taxa present in others. 


# Heirarchical
```{r}
# Compute Aitchison distance (Euclidean on CLR data)
dist_matrix <- dist(clr_taxa_filt_t, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc, main = "Hierarchical Clustering")

# Convert hclust object to a dendrogram
dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)

# Assuming you have a vector of patient IDs (e.g., "patient_id") corresponding to samples
# Example: patient_id <- c("Patient1", "Patient2", "Patient1", "Patient3", "Patient2")
patient_id <- meta$`Patient Id` # Replace with your actual patient ID data

patient_colors <- as.factor(patient_id)
palette_colors <- rainbow(length(unique(patient_colors)))

# Color the labels with distinct colors for each patient
dend <- dend %>%
  set("labels_col", palette_colors[patient_colors]) %>%
  set("labels_cex", 0.8)  # Adjust label size if needed

# Plot the dendrogram with colored labels
plot(dend, main = "Hierarchical Clustering by Patient")
```

# K means 
```{r}
set.seed(123)
k <- 3 # Set number of clusters
kmeans_result <- kmeans(clr_taxa_filt_t, centers = k)

# Add cluster labels to metadata
meta$Cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)

# PCA Plot with clusters
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = meta$Cluster)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  ggtitle("K-means Clustering of Microbiome Samples")
```
M070 ends up in their own cluster with k=3 and k=2...

# UMAP
```{r}
umap_result <- umap(clr_taxa_filt_t)

# Convert UMAP output to a dataframe
umap_df <- as.data.frame(umap_result$layout)
umap_df$PersonID <- meta$`Patient Id`

# Plot UMAP
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = PersonID)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() 
```
```{r}
umap_result <- umap(clr_taxa_filt_t)

# Convert UMAP result to a data frame for easy plotting
umap_df <- as.data.frame(umap_result$layout)
umap_df$Cluster <- as.factor(meta$Cluster)  # Add your cluster or grouping variable here

# Plot UMAP with ellipses for each cluster
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color = Cluster)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", size = 1) +  # Add ellipses based on normal distribution
  theme_minimal() + 
  ggtitle("UMAP of CLR-Transformed Microbiome Data with Clusters and Ellipses")
```


# Permanova
```{r}
library(vegan)

# Compute Aitchison distance
dist_matrix <- dist(clr_data, method = "euclidean")

# Run PERMANOVA (testing clustering by PersonID)
permanova_result <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ metadata$PersonID, data = metadata)

# Print results
print(permanova_result)

```
